subject: copr: fallback when bucket path meets error (#66070)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for PR #66070 in `pkg/store/copr`. Changes are defensive and correctness-preserving: bucket splitting now detects inconsistent bucket/range/location states and falls back to region-only splitting; `SplitKeyRangesByLocations` avoids prior panic-prone/incorrect last-location assumptions by re-locating overflow ranges with a bounded budget; and "Request range exceeds bound" handling adds bounded self-healing retries (with richer diagnostics) when the error persists even in skip-buckets mode. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or compatibility issues found in the touched store/copr behavior.
